place.source_title: United States Post Office, Arkdale, Wisconsin 54613

brief: Tiny one-storey frame village post office: a low gable-front building clad in vertical board siding painted tan, with a deep eave over a front of one big window, the lettered 'UNITED STATES POST OFFICE / ARKDALE WISCONSIN 54613' signboard, a glazed door with a notice panel, a blue collection box on a concrete walk and lawn around it, among trees and small cottages.

facade.notes: the Arkdale WI post office (c.1960): a tiny one-storey gable-front building in tan vertical siding with a deep projecting eave over one big window and a glazed door, a blue mailbox and a light; a lawn with a walk

why.note: the village post office: one small public room, a counter and a sorting room behind, a flag and a blue box
a leased rural post office: a builder's shed-scale building
